caseNameFull: Singletary, Secretary, Florida Department of Corrections v. Duest

opinions.text:
C. A. 11th Cir. Motion of *1049respondent for leave to proceed informa pauperis granted. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Brecht v. Abrahamson, ante, p. 619.

Justice Blackmun, Justice Stevens, and Justice O’Connor dissent.
